items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 25 October 2026 9:44am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 25 October 2026 at 9:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

There's a Severe Gale Warning in operation, becoming a Gale Warning for this afternoon.


##Synopsis##

Very deep low (Storm Boelo) near northern Scotland, slowly moving towards southern Norway.


##Wind##

West gale 8 or severe gale 9, gradually decreasing 7 or gale 8 this afternoon, then gradually 6 or 7 during the evening. Backing southwest 4 or 5 overnight, then south or southeast 5 to 7 tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Rough or very rough, becoming moderate or rough later today, then slight or moderate overnight, then moderate end of this period.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southeast 5 to 7 during Monday morning, veering south or southwest 6 or 7 during the afternoon, then increasing 7 or gale 8 in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, soon becoming moderate or rough, then rough or very rough later on Monday until later in the night.


##Weather##

Rain spreading from the southwest, becoming mostly fair for a while in the afternoon, then rain again later in the day, clearing overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, becoming moderate or poor in the rain.
